status: Bounded photo/imagery-based courtyard study, not a measured reconstruction or complete interior
label: 天师府二门内侧至玉皇殿石阶前院落观察
scope: 独立转场至二门北侧院落；仅沿院落铺地到玉皇殿石阶前，保守避让石阶前围合区，不登阶、不进入殿内，不连接头门或私第。
notice: 独立院落观察转场，不表示从头门连续步行进入二门。双向普通实拍支持院落空间关系，约27.9米路线、东西方向、院落尺寸、围合设施位置及高差为照片/影像估算；不是扫描或360°全景。路线在石阶前围合区南侧转向估计东侧并止于台阶前。围栏内设施的正式名称与年代未核实，深度、石雕细纹和殿内陈设未重建。

georeference.basis: Existing references/georeference/tianshi/alignment.json unchanged. Imagery metadata 2023-10-30, nominal 5m field; real model accuracy not measured.

featureEvidence.feature: bounded open court between second gate and hall stair
featureEvidence.observation: Opposite views show the same axial paving, three-opening gate rear facade, stair and enclosed facility.
featureEvidence.estimated: 31x25m displayed paving envelope, camera placement, grade and 27.855m route; no surveyed plan.

featureEvidence.feature: three gate openings with flanking pink chambers
featureEvidence.observation: Three open middle bays, closed side bays, repeated red columns and painted horizontal beam.
featureEvidence.estimated: Uses existing roof center and approximate 19m body/7m depth; column diameters and exact partitions estimated.

featureEvidence.observation: Stone rail envelope and circular top are visible.
featureEvidence.estimated: Conservative bounds x [-2.3,2.3], z [15.8,20.5]m; formal name, age and underground depth unverified. No historic identity assigned.

featureEvidence.observation: Diamond upper lattice, three front door openings, stone column bases, grey cover tiles, stone terrace rails.
featureEvidence.estimated: Dimensions, tile spacing, profiles and new rail frames estimated. Carved reliefs are not reconstructed. Door voids deliberately stop at dark flat visibility masks, not an interior.

featureEvidence.observation: Native-resolution rectified source pixels, recorded letter forms retained.
featureEvidence.estimated: Photo lighting remains, not scanned PBR; not enlarged or AI-generated; exact brushwork beyond resolution unresolved.

featureEvidence.observation: 30 imported near-court mesh objects from existing independent Tianshi imagery-derived tree asset.
featureEvidence.estimated: Retains existing sampled stem positions, branch approximations and tree heights; does not claim individual-tree survey.

validation.limits: Only numerical consistency of this estimated model; not site accuracy. No browser or physical-phone performance test in C workstream.

reproduction: Set TEMP/TMP and BLENDER_USER_CONFIG/SCRIPTS/DATAFILES to workstream-local folders.
limitations: Independent observation transition from exterior interface; no surveyed continuous connection from head gate.
Only bounded court is entered; hall interiors, shrine contents and private residence remain unmodeled.
Paving topology is observed but exact slab sizes/joints and grade are original approximate materials, not a survey.
No real relief carving, cloud-wing carving, well depth, exact floor levels or physical-phone benchmark.
Source photographs remain ordinary photographs, not panoramas. Their camera poses are uncalibrated.
Photo rights remain with original author; existing local-research restriction retained.
